notes: the first branch ends at Abu Zayd; the second («ح وحدثنا محمد بن المثنى») runs through Abd al-Samad and the father (bare, a relation) to Abu Zayd al-Ansari; both write their own names, so the tail is null
«- قال أبو بكر وقال غير عبد الأعلى عن عمرو بن بجدان، عن أبي زيد -» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
«أبي» (occurrence 5) is the father of Abd al-Samad, bare: relation
